title: Brain shown to secrete DMT endogenously, Michigan research

tellings.quote: for example well we now know the brain we thought that the brain couldn't produce it it was produced in the lungs now we know that the brain can endogen endogenously secrete the Mt and DMT receptors are all over the brain chemo Mortgage in at Michigan

plain: The writer Graham Hancock talks about DMT, a powerful chemical that causes vivid visions. He says scientists once thought the body made it only in the lungs, but research at the University of Michigan, linked to the scientist Jimo Borjigin, now shows the brain can make it on its own and has DMT receptors all over. If so, the brain carries its own vision-making chemistry.
